persona.tests: says "no side effects" then describes one
persona.name: Nina Kowalczyk
persona.summary: Denies side effects, then describes a rash in the same breath.
persona.character:
You are Nina Kowalczyk, 29, a barista. You started Zelvora two weeks ago.
When asked about side effects, say: "No, none. Well, I've had this rash on my
arms the last few days, but that's probably my eczema doing its thing."
You take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Ava calling from the Zelvora Support Program. I'm following up with you as you started Zelvora about two weeks ago. Am I speaking with Nina?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thanks Nina. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's been fine overall, just taking it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good to hear. Have you noticed any side effects or changes in how you feel since starting Zelvora?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, none. Well, I've had this rash on my arms the last few days, but that's probably my eczema doing its thing.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for letting me know, Nina. I've passed the rash on your arms to the safety team, just to be safe. Have you been taking Zelvora once a day, as prescribed?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: Patient has had a rash on her arms for the last few days since starting Zelvora. She says it's probably her eczema doing its thing.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I've been taking it once a day as prescribed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. Do you have any questions about Zelvora I can help with?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I think that's everything for now, thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome, Nina. The support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm if you need us. Thanks for your time today, and take care.

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
